title: Study firstmate's work handling (M1) pinned at 6407052f
summary: Retry the M1 study of firstmate's work handling, pinned to the full commit SHA 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827 that the user gave (pinned-source/ itself has no SHA). The study must carry that SHA in pin.json and every citation, and its validation must be reproducible by a kept test. It must also fix the earlier minor flaws.

defaults_applied.how: Every claim cites the pinned SHA, path, line range and a verbatim quote.
A kept test validates the study against real pinned-source text; cargo test and clippy must pass.
Validation must be reproducible by the verifier running cargo test.
The JSON study files are non-Rust, so each is listed with its reason in docs/non-rust-files.md.
Every claim's enforcement is tagged mechanism or prose-only.
One study plus the minimum test and doc changes.

assumptions: The pin SHA is 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827, as the user stated; pinned-source/ contents are read as that commit.
The studies/ tree from the failed attempt is absent, so the study is created from scratch.
The study follows the typed records in crates/athena-cap-study (pin, claims, rationales, model, validation).
The earlier tree's docs/non-rust-files.md studies/** row is still needed for the new JSON files.

acceptance_criteria.text: studies/firstmate-work-handling/pin.json holds the full SHA 6407052f4c521e39401ce2305dfa45d201249827; no placeholder such as UNRESOLVED-PIN-SHA appears anywhere in the study.
Every citation in claims.json and rationales.json carries that SHA, an existing path and line range, and a verbatim quote from the pinned tree.
Run cargo test: a kept test in the repository validates studies/firstmate-work-handling, including the wrong-SHA and quote-match rules, and passes.
Every claim is tagged mechanism or prose-only, never 'not examined'. Model transitions with guard 'none' do not say code evaluates a guard.
docs/non-rust-files.md lists the studies/** JSON files with their reason, and CHANGELOG.md names the change.
Run cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy; both report no problems.

out_of_scope: Changing the study capability's design or rules beyond what a kept validation test needs.
Studying systems other than firstmate's work handling.
Editing records/, athena.toml, defaults.toml, or CI configuration.
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass chance than reference: the study is large and the prior attempt failed verification.
